missionText.briefing:
Welcome to the world championships ice hockey!

The objective of this mission is that you shoot
the "puck" in the opponents goal.

Since you will have to hit your opponent quite
often it is required that you play this game
in god mode, start the game with:

tank -god -loadsofweapons

Also I suggest you play the game in high
resolution mode.
